info.title: PerfectParser Public API
info.description: Welcome to the PerfectParser Developer API documentation. You can use our API to programmatically create and configure Parsers, submit documents for bulk extraction, check extraction status, and retrieve structured results. We also support outbound webhooks to deliver parsed data directly to your server in real-time.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all custom document parsers configured in your workspace.

post.description: Programmatically define a new custom document parser, detailing its name, description, result mode, and optionally predefined fields.

name.description: The user-facing name of the parser.

description.description: Optional details about what this parser processes.
description.example: Extracts vendor, line items, and totals from invoices.

result_mode.description: How the results are structured. one_per_file groups extraction into a single object, one_per_page separates extraction per page.

fields.description: Predefined schema fields to configure parser manually.

409.description: Parser with this name already exists.

get.description: Retrieve configuration details, result mode, and JSON Schema of a specific parser.

patch.description: Update specific fields of a parser configuration (e.g. name, description, result mode, or fields).

delete.description: Permanently soft-delete a parser configuration from your account.

post.description: Triggers AI field detection from a sample document. Mode A: upload file via multipart/form-data. Mode B: reference existing sample_file_id via JSON. Charges 1 credit per page.

sample_file_id.description: Existing sample file ID from a previous detect-fields call or GET parser.

400.description: No sample file uploaded or schema already exists.

get.description: Retrieve a list of extraction batches.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return extractions updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

post.description: Queue one or more files for structured data extraction. Credits are deducted based on total page counts.

400.description: Unsupported file or parser not configured.

Retrieve full extracted JSON data for all documents completed in the extraction batch.
Download extraction results formatted as JSON, CSV, or Excel.
Retrieve full metadata and extracted data for a single document within an extraction batch. Both path IDs must match the stored parent-child relationship.
Download the structured result data of a single document within an extraction batch in JSON, CSV, or Excel.
Returns identity and credit balance for the authenticated API key.
Returns credit balance and active purchase summary.
Retrieve list of active outbound webhook subscriptions with cursor pagination.

post.description: Subscribe to real-time events. Perfect for syncing directly to Zapier or no-code platforms.

secret.description: Optional static token sent in X-Webhook-Secret header (min 8 chars).

signing_secret.description: HMAC signing secret — returned once on create.

get.description: Retrieve configuration of a webhook subscription, including recent callback logs.

200.description: Webhook detail with delivery attempts list.

patch.description: Partially update URL, events, or active status.

delete.description: Disable/deactivate the webhook. No further callbacks will be triggered.

post.description: Sends a synthetic extraction.job_completed payload with test: true to verify endpoint configuration.

X-Webhook-Secret.description: Static shared webhook secret token provided by the user.
